list_user_context_authored.text: I'm the only engineer on Mnema — most days are building, not meetings.
Figma time is real work even when it looks like browsing.
Ana is my design partner; calls with her are planning, not chat.
Ship the GPUI app to parity before the year ends.
I prefer local models for anything personal.
